clear_saltmarket.name: Smog on Saltmarket
clear_saltmarket.description: The Murk is pooling on Saltmarket Street. Knock down 8 of its creatures.

warden.name: The Warden
warden.description: Something bigger guards the way to Canal Works. Defeat the Smog Warden.

foreman.name: The Sludge Foreman
foreman.description: The Murk answers to something at the end of Canal Works. End it.

rail_rumble.name: Rail Yard Rumble
rail_rumble.description: Dock thugs are stripping the rail yards east of the canal. Put 8 of them on the ground.

market_lights.name: Market Lights
market_lights.description: Punks run the Night Market after dark. Knock down 10 of them so the stalls can open.

furnace_baron.name: The Furnace Baron
furnace_baron.description: The smoke over the city comes from one man's furnace. Climb to the Smokestack Refinery and put out the Baron.
